title: Adopt/extend the existing persistent engineering loop and prove the observer/owner-action bridge
base_commit_note: Cut from origin/main at this commit. The reviewed candidate e7f5d98a was parented on 702d6e4cdb4e (T-04/PBB-177), which verifier PBB-263 independently FAILED; T-05 was therefore re-parented off it. That commit is NOT an ancestor of this branch and nothing here depends on T-04's bytes.
authority_note: Author receipt only. C-05, C-F15, C-F18 and C-F19 stay UNVERIFIED until an independent opus-chain QC review of this exact candidate. This is not self-approval and no check is marked passed here.
acceptance_clause_verbatim: Bind the smallest existing supported observer/owner-action adapter; documented native background controls alone do not pass. Prove create/read/dispatch/ACK/completion/restart/stop on one synthetic action with actual IDs, duplicate safety and independent observation. Hold only dependent unattended effects.

adopted_existing_loop.not_replaced: The owner handler is byte-identical to the existing one. The adapter differs only by the environment-override extension recorded below; every existing command, state machine, table, receipt marker, lease and ready-queue path is unchanged.

extension.why: A real launchd proof job must be registerable under its own label with its own durable store, so the running production generation 2 is not disturbed and no write leaves the mandated lane/temp roots. Without the propagation, the owner-handler child would silently write to the production control/state while the parent read the isolated store.

Propagate PB_STATE_DIR/PB_LABEL/PB_PLIST/PB_TMP/PB_CACHE to the owner-handler child and the launchd plist when set.

extension.not_changed: No command, argument, state name, table, receipt/provenance rule, lease rule, tick lock, ready-queue rule, report interval or effect-once guard was changed.

deviations: The proof ran a real launchd job under the isolated label ai.blackceo.pb-eng-loop-pbb220 and an in-lane plist instead of reusing the running production label ai.blackceo.pb-eng-loop. Reason: the mandated write isolation allows writes only in this lane and the temp root, and the production generation 2 was already running. The production job was observed read-only (launchctl print rc 0).

The adapter gained two environment overrides and their propagation (extension diff above) to make the isolated real-launchd proof possible. Defaults are byte-for-byte the previous production identity; no existing behavior changed.

The restart proof restarts the same run_id/generation 1 (the replacement observes the same durable store). It does not create a second generation, because the acceptance asks for restart, not a new owner generation.
repair_note: Repair of verifier PBB-279's FAIL on e7f5d98a. D1: PB_* configuration is read at use time (refresh_config/external_env) instead of captured at import, so the selftest child writes the sandbox store. D2/D3/D4: the stop ownership guard, the generation bound and the payload/body JSON boundary refuse with a reason instead of raising. Regression tests: CONTROL/tests/test_eng_loop_guards.py. The clause evidence below was produced on the earlier PBB-220 candidate and is retained as historical record, not as proof of this repair; this artifact makes no new PASS claim.
